note: Erdae text for keys the installed game defines (written to localisation/replace). One group per surface; a module that writes the same keys can switch a group off with ctx.skipLoc. Placeholders ($NAME|fmt$), colour codes and texticons follow the key they replace, so the engine can still fill them. Every value is ZIN's own wording from the glossary (data/glossary.json).
